cooking:
Basic Pokémon Food
Requires any 3: Berries, Basic Ingredients or above.
Insight / Beauty + Cooking: Result = Units of Poke food.

High-Performance Pokémon Food
Requires any 3: X-Item, Sitrus Berries, Basic Ingredients or above.
Insight / Beauty + Cooking: Result = Units of High-Performance Poke food.

Gourmet Pokémon Food
Requires any 4: Happiness Increasing Berries, Honey, Tiny/Big Mushroom, Gourmet Ingredients or above.
Insight / Beauty + Cooking: Result = Units of Gourmet Poke food.

Deluxe Pokémon Food
Requires 1 of each: Happiness Increasing Berry, Honey, Big Mushroom, Gourmet Ingredients or above.
Insight / Beauty + Cooking DC8: Result = Units of Deluxe Poke food. (Fail makes Gourmet)

Meal / Rations
Requires any 3: Berries, Basic Ingredients or above.
Insight / Beauty + Cooking: Result = Units of Rations.

Gourmet Meal / Rations
Requires any 3: Berries, Honey, Tiny/Big Mushroom, Gourmet Ingredients or above.
Insight / Beauty + Cooking: Result = Units of Gourmet Rations.

Deluxe Meal / Rations
Requires 1 of each: Berries, Honey, Big Mushroom, Gourmet Ingredients or above.
Insight / Beauty + Cooking DC8: Result = Units of Gourmet Rations. (Fail makes Gourmet)

Red Apricorn:
DC1: Poke Ball
DC2: Repeat Ball
DC3: Fast Ball

Blue Apricorn:
DC3: Dive Ball
DC3: Feather Ball
DC3: Aurora Ball

Cyan Apricorn:
DC3: Lure Ball
DC3: Quick Ball
DC3: Net Ball

Pink Apricorn:
DC3: Love Ball
DC3: Heal Ball
DC3: Fae Ball

Green Apricorn:
DC2: Nest Ball
DC3: Great Ball
DC4: Friend Ball

White Apricorn:
DC2: Premier Ball
DC3: Dawn Ball
DC4: Timer Ball

Gray Apricorn:
DC3: Moon Ball
DC3: Tech Ball
DC4: Heavy Ball

Black Apricorn:
DC3: Dusk Ball
DC4: Ultra Ball
DC5: Luxury Ball

How to craft them:
A character must roll Dexterity / Clever + Crafts, meeting the DC to create a ball from an Apricorn.

High Quality Poke Balls:
A character who exceeds the DC required by 4, for instance rolling 7 successes while crafting a Great Ball, will create a HQ or high quality variant of the ball they were crafting. This gives an automatic success on top of its base catch rate.

A player who exceeds the DC by 6 will gain an additional automatic success with a HQ+ ball.

For what a ball does use /item [ball name]
craftinghealingitems:
Potions
Requires: Energy Root or Vitality Herb or three Sitrus Berry.
Insight / Clever + Medicine: Result = Units of Healing.

Full Heal
Requires any three: Different Status healing berries or Heal Powder.
Insight / Clever + Medicine: 1/2 Result Rounded Down = Amount of Full Heals.

Full Restore
Requires: Energy Root or Vitality Herb and Heal Powder or Lum Berry.
Insight / Clever + Medicine: 1/3 Result rounded down = Amount of Full Restores.

Revive
Requires: 2 Revival Herbs.
Insight / Clever + Medicine: 1/3 Result rounded down = Amount of Revives.

Max Revive
Requires: Revival Herb and Vitality Herb or Energy Root.
Insight / Clever + Medicine: 1/3 Result rounded down = Amount of Max Revives.

For how each healing item works use /item [item name]
